title.title: The Correspondence of Esther Roberts Hunt Collins

msIdentifier.institution: Friends Historical Library of Swarthmore College

projectDesc.p: The correspondence of Quaker minister Esther Roberts Hunt Collins is stored at the Friends Historical Library of Swarthmore College. With the generous support of H. David and Joyce E. Hunt, Library staff scanned and transcribed these letters in 2024 and encoded the text in TEI.

div.p: These lines may inform thee that we are favored with health (for which with other blessings bountifully bestowed, I desire to be truly thankful). Our brother Robert has moved over to Westland and settled to school keeping at the meeting house; their son Joseph has been in a week feeble state and almost as soon as they got to housekeeping. He was taken very ill, and so continued until his death which was about 3 weeks ago.

Thus far wrote in the 2nd month and not having an opportunity of convenience remained unfinished, but there being now some prospect of an opportunity. I have again taken up my pen the 4th 5th month 1780 and may inform that we are favored with health at this time. Also, Jonas’s family, brother Robert’s family,

John Moores and I believe it is so pretty generally I saw the most of our relations of this side of the mountains this day at meeting. It has felt to me that the visit our dear Friends paid us from your parts had an enlivening affect for a while, but oh how like it was complained by the prophet our righteousness being as the morning clouds and early dew quickly passeth away—that at times discouragement exceedingly prevails, though something more lively has attended some of our last meetings, which has been humblingly encouraging. I wish that we may be remembered by thee and others when favored to draw near to petition & intercede for the people, remembering that the prayers of the righteous awaiteth much.

The people’s minds much a afloat going to settle now counties Evan Evans with his family has moved to go to Licotke and many more from Virginia & other parts even those who were well settled. Some that have gone to Miami have wrote back to their acquaintances to inform them of the land, which they write to read Deuteronomy the 8th chapter for a perfect account be. I feel a desire to hear from thee and the rest of my endeared friends & relations when opportunity offers.
div.closer: With desires for thy preservation every way I remain thy affectionate Sister Esther Hunt My love to thy Wife & children & Hope Stokes, Elizabeth Hunt with the rest as if named

postscript.p: As thee desired some account of brother Robert, I thought it might be safe to uniform that he settled at Westland to school keeping has kept one quarter (and in that, as other things concludes hard usage and not justice done him) they not thinking him altogether qualified for a master, let him know it. Therefore he is done with that and is now last & shoemaking & expects to stay here this summer and may be to move to Bridgeport in the fall, I believe it best not to write much on this subject, yet may add that my sense is that it takes a great deal to humble some of us, so as to give us a right sight of our own imperfections, and for want of that sense, we are too apt to reflect on others as faulty not enough considering the beam in our own eye.
